name: Securities Transaction Report 2
definition: Details of the securities transaction report.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the transaction.

ExecutingParty.name: Executing Party
ExecutingParty.definition: Identification of the entity executing the transaction. ||Usage:|For legal entities, use the legal entity identifier. For non-legal entities, this field shall be populated with an identifier as specified in the local regulation.

SubmittingParty.name: Submitting Party
SubmittingParty.definition: Entity submitting the transaction report to the competent authority.

TechnicalAttributes.name: Technical Attributes
TechnicalAttributes.definition: Data used for exchanges between national competent authorities, not to be used by reporting entities.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
